title: Vaginal Tactile Imaging for the Assessment of Pelvic Organ Prolapse Repair Efficiency
brief_summary: Female patients with POP will be evaluated for vaginal elasticity using vaginal tactile imaging both before and after surgery for the repair of the POP. Surgical repair will be performed by a single surgeon who will perform either a laparoscopic or vaginal repair.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any woman undergoing POP repair

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women above or below the age limit
